displayName: Scheduled query falló (refresco o chequeos de calidad)

conditions.displayName: Error en un run de BigQuery Data Transfer

documentation.content: refresco-diario-incremental or chequeos-calidad-diarios failed. If it is an ASSERT in sql/15_checks.sql, the message says which one: dead-letter growth, aggregates that do not match events_raw, duplicate streaming rows, a category jump or too many uncategorized purchases. See Transfers in BigQuery.
